homeContent.about1: Niah National Park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its remarkable archaeological significance, extensive cave systems, prehistoric remains, rock art, and rich biodiversity.
homeContent.about2: The park is home to the famous Niah Caves, where evidence of prehistoric human settlement provides valuable insight into the early history of Borneo.
homeContent.landscapeText: From vast limestone caves to ancient rock art and tropical rainforest, discover the places that make Niah National Park extraordinary.
homeContent.greatCaveText: Step inside Niah's spectacular limestone cave system and explore one of its most important archaeological landscapes.
homeContent.paintedText: Discover prehistoric rock paintings and traces of Niah's ancient human story.
homeContent.rainforestText: Walk through lush tropical rainforest and boardwalks on the journey towards Niah's caves.
homeContent.whyText: Hidden within the rainforests of northern Sarawak, Niah National Park is a remarkable meeting point of nature and human history. Its vast limestone caves preserve archaeological discoveries, prehistoric paintings, and evidence of people who lived here thousands of years ago.
homeContent.videoText: Take a closer look at the rainforest, caves, and extraordinary heritage that make Niah National Park unforgettable.
homeContent.journeyText: Follow the journey from the park headquarters through rainforest, heritage sites and caves towards some of Niah's most remarkable landmarks.
homeContent.prepareText: A little preparation will make your journey through Niah's rainforest and caves safer and more comfortable.
homeContent.footwearText: Wear comfortable shoes with good grip as trails and cave surfaces can be slippery.
homeContent.torchText: Some sections of the caves are naturally dark, so bring a reliable torch.
homeContent.waterText: Stay hydrated during the walk through the tropical rainforest and cave system.
homeContent.repellentText: Bring insect repellent for greater comfort while travelling through the rainforest.
homeContent.journeyAria: Journey from Park Headquarters to Painted Cave

speciesRequest.title: New Species Request
speciesRequest.resolveFirst: Resolve the new species request above before reviewing this plant submission. All plant decisions remain locked until the backend confirms an approved request and its resulting species association.
speciesRequest.loadFailed: The linked species request could not be verified. Plant review remains locked.

states.error: Species request could not be verified

notices.loading: Refreshing the submission to verify the linked species request. Plant review is temporarily locked.
notices.pending: This submission proposes a new species. Review and resolve the species request before making a decision on the plant observation.
notices.approved: The returned request is approved and its resulting species matches this submission. Plant review may proceed according to the observation status.
notices.rejected: The species request was rejected. The plant observation has not been automatically rejected; plant review remains locked.
notices.correction: Species information requires correction before this plant submission can be reviewed.
notices.incomplete: The request says Approved, but a matching resulting species with a scientific name is missing from the submission. Plant review remains locked.
notices.unavailable: This submission references a species request, but its details are unavailable. A linked-request backend contract is required; plant review remains locked.
notices.error: The linked request could not be loaded or its identity is inconsistent. Observation details remain available; plant review remains locked.
notices.unknown: The species request status is missing or unsupported. Plant review remains locked until resolution can be verified.
notices.saving: Saving the species decision and verifying the resulting submission. Plant review remains locked.
